contexts.text: Instruments of violence are their swords () = that falsities and evils have inflicted violence on truths and goods. ( = that doctrinal things serve to destroy the works of charity... Swords = doctrinal things; for swords = the truths of faith by which combat is waged against falsities and evils; thus swords = doctrinal things. AC 6353.) AE 443:6.
That sword = falsity combating and slaying. Illustrated.
A great sword () = falsity combating against truth. ( = the destruction of truth through the falsities of evil. AR 308.) AE 367.

If anyone shall kill with the sword, with the sword must he be killed () = that he who destroys the soul of another by means of falsities, shall be destroyed and shall perish by falsities. AE 811:24. AE 812.

Which has the stroke of a sword and lived () = the quality of those natural things by which the things taken from the natural sense of the Word were conjoined. A sword = the combat of falsity against truth, and the destruction of truth through falsities.
